title: Persian Old Version Bible (Tarjome-ye Ghadim, 1895), full Bible, one verse per line
period: 19th century (1895 Old Persian Version), Classical-leaning modern Persian; a distant proxy for medieval Persian
notes: License: 'public-domain' is stated for translation id 'pesOPV' in the eBible corpus licence table https://github.com/BibleNLP/ebible/blob/2bde52b4c2cfd7056cf4ed07c48969647df79744/metadata/licences.tsv (taken from eBible.org's copyright page, https://ebible.org/pesOPV/copr.htm). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 5,670,496 bytes; eBible corpus format: one verse per line aligned to a fixed versification (empty lines for verses the translation lacks; '<range>' marks merged verses, a few letters each). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'persian') gives 3,068,420 characters. eBible credits the translation to 'Wycliffe Bible Translators' in its table; the Persian Old Version is the 1895 Bruce/Glen revision.
